items.quote: the citizens of Shechem so that they acted treacherously against Abimelek
items.contrast: The citizens of Shechem are the actors; Abimelek is the target of their treachery.
items.reason: A reader might reverse the roles and name Abimelek, but “they” refers to the citizens of Shechem, while “against Abimelek” identifies the target. The wording and key correctly resolve this actor-versus-recipient distinction.
